FAQ.title: Frequently Asked Questions
FAQ.description: Answers to our clients' most common questions.

q1.question: How does payment work?
q1.answer: Payment is made in two stages: 50% upfront when the project starts, and the remaining 50% after the finished project is delivered. Payment can be made via cash, card, or bank transfer.

q2.question: What if the project deadline is delayed?
q2.answer: We strictly adhere to deadlines. If there is a delay on our side, compensation as specified in the contract will be provided. We report to you at every stage.

q3.question: Are domain and hosting included in the price?
q3.answer: Yes! All our plans include a .uz domain and hosting free for 1 year. Additionally, an SSL certificate is also provided free of charge.

q4.question: Can I modify the site later?
q4.answer: Absolutely! Pro and Premium plans include an admin panel, allowing you to manage content independently. For technical changes, we are always ready to help.

q5.question: Is the site SEO-optimized?
q5.answer: Yes, all our sites are built with basic SEO optimization: meta tags, speed optimization, mobile responsiveness, Schema.org markup. For deeper SEO, a separate plan is available.

q6.question: Is technical support available?
q6.answer: Yes! We provide 6 months of free technical support after project delivery. During this period, we fix all bugs and issues for free. After that, you can continue the partnership.

q7.question: How much does a Telegram bot cost?
q7.answer: Telegram bot pricing starts from $80 depending on functionality. From simple order bots to complex bots with payment system integration — individual pricing is agreed for each.

q8.question: Why choose Dream Tech?
q8.answer: 55+ delivered projects, 5+ years of experience, official contracts, 6-month guarantee, and response within 1 hour — we only deliver results. Our experience with major brands like SANY and Kamafarm will be applied to your project too.
